annotations.title: Get an MP's votes on a day

description: Get how an MP voted (YES, NO, ABSTAIN, ABSENT) in every voting held on one day of a plenary sitting, with the title and topic of each voting. Days on which votings were held are listed by get-mp-voting-stats.

date.description: Day of the sitting (one of the `dates` of the sitting in get-proceedings), in YYYY-MM-DD format

id.description: ID of the MP (poseł): the `id` field from get-members

sitting.description: Number of the plenary sitting (posiedzenie Sejmu): the `number` field from get-proceedings

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-mp-votings

vote.description: YES, NO, ABSTAIN, ABSENT; VOTE_VALID for votings on a list

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: Get an MP's votes on a day
